newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian ceramics maker to float shares.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian ceramics maker to float shares.

text.p: Indonesian ceramics maker PT Intikeramik Alamasri Industri said on Friday it will raise around 75 billion rupiah from an offering of 100 million shares, a 29.41 percent stake, to the public next week.
Intikeramik said in an annoucement that the offering will be at 750 rupiah per share with a nominal value of 500 rupiah and will be held between May 14 to May 16.
The firm, which plans to list on the Jakarta stock exchange on June 4, said it expected to post a net profit of 28.5 billion rupiah in 1997 against 7.5 billion rupiah in 1996.
